title: AI风险观测站：从年报AI披露中洞察社会韧性
summary: 研究利用LLM对1362家英国上市公司9821份年报进行两阶段分类，发现AI风险披露从2020年的2.8%升至2025年的41.2%，但仅4.3%属实质性披露，且行业与市场板块差异显著。
summary_en: Using LLMs to process 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies, this study finds AI risk disclosure rose from 2.8% in 2020 to 41.2% in 2025, yet only 4.3% is substantive, with large variation across sectors and market segments.
